review.diagnosis: The current adapter lacks command-level process control. Docker implements a shell process-group wrapper and a second exec kill helper. Daytona deletes a dedicated session. Render SDK request cancellation alone does not terminate the process.
review.liveFinding: The prototype used only public Render SDK exec and public Mastra WorkspaceSandbox/createWorkspaceTools on unpatched core 1.75.0. Normal, abort and timeout cases all passed; ordinary parent and child stopped, delayed files were prevented, and unrelated work plus sandbox were preserved.
review.ownership: Preserving an attached sandbox does not prevent the adapter from terminating commands it launched. Current owned-sandbox cancellation already works by terminating the entire sandbox.
review.reporting: The separate Mastra core false-killed-on-error defect remains. A confirmed killed:true result works on current core; uncertain termination errors still require truthful core wording.
review.scope: Feasibility prototype only; no production Render adapter changes. It requires setsid -w and tests ordinary descendants that remain in the process group. It does not establish protection against deliberate session escape, PID/identity races, tampering, or failed control-plane calls.
review.exitStatus: The actual Render exec exit was 9 after setsid reported its child received a signal. The probe preserved this observed exit rather than fabricating 137 or 124. Production exit reporting and cleanup/error races still need implementation and tests.
